canada.title: Land parcel transferred to City of Yellowknife, to be used for new housing development
canada.summary: The 41-hectare parcel of land on the north side of Frame Lake is set to become home to a new, primarily residential neighbourhood. It's a key part of the city's strategy to address its current housing crisis and plan for projected growth from defence investments in the city.
